## Gate stamp

The triage author stamps the semantic call. This write-back is not the round-1 ceiling; spend N≥3 takes the panel-deposit snapshot.

P1 is leftover(#4916) Tax B (pain-audit 5783468254; Handoff 5783498663; leftover-split parking on this number). Always-on agents-entry still orders a main.md read on the identity-only / read-only first prompt. Injected-surface remainder (Stop 1 P1 / Tax A) stays on #4916 and is leftover-deferred to open #3014. Capture remainder stays on #4544.

Re-measured at dispatch SHA `d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d`:

- `content/templates/agents-entry.md` L4: `Full guidelines: .deft/core/main.md`
- L20 load list: `load AGENTS.md / main.md / USER.md / xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json`
- L20 else-clause: `else main → USER → PROJECT-DEFINITION`
- Consumer AGENTS.md is 38335 bytes. agents-entry.md is 19233 bytes.
- Identity-only detector exists in setup SKILL.md L686-L688 (empty plan.items AND no convention-valid lifecycle scopes). It does not skip the always-on main.md pointers.
- skipFatPath on rapid/minimal lightens only triage welcome, optional network, staleness (ceremony-dial.ts L139-140; session-start.ts L1771-1772).

What this P1 is not:

- Not skipFatPath / ceremony-dial unload of host-injected AGENTS.md.
- Not a default thin AGENTS profile (#3014).
- Not the capture remainder on #4544.
- Not auto-seeding `xbrief/active/`.
- Not mid-run AGENTS rewrite (#3164).
- Not the injected-surface load tax leftover-deferred on #4916 to #3014.

Open forks the critic may take: recut every always-on main.md pointer (L4, L20 load list, L20 else-clause) so identity-only / read-only / rapid does not mandate main.md; skip main.md via the existing identity-only detector; or treat the read as expected cost and close.

Charter: open critique, round 1, fresh critic. Tree reads are pinned to `d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d`. Input stops at comment 5787798332.

## Verdict

Take a narrowed fork 1. Recut only the **load mandates** (L20 load list, L20 else-clause, and the mirrors listed below). Keep L4 as it is. Do not use the identity-only detector as the switch. Do not close as expected cost. Also move the one rule from main.md that read-only sessions need into the always-on surface.

## Re-verified anchors

- `agents-entry.md` L4, L20 load list, L20 else-clause: text confirmed. agents-entry is 19233 bytes. Consumer AGENTS.md is 38335 bytes. main.md is 37592 bytes, so this read roughly doubles the first-prompt load.
- Setup SKILL.md L686-L688 identity-only detector: confirmed. It is **prose only**. `git grep -i 'identityOnly|isIdentityOnly' packages/core/src` finds no hits outside tests.
- skipFatPath: confirmed at `ceremony-dial.ts` L147/L155 and at `session-start.ts` L1922/L1981/L1994/L1999. It gates triage welcome, optional network, and staleness. It never touches main.md.

## Findings

### F1 — `sharpens-framing`: L4 is a locator that code parses, not a load mandate

Evidence: `packages/core/src/doctor/manifest.ts` L124-L136 `parseInstallRootFromAgentsMd` falls back to `FULL_GUIDELINES_RE = /Full guidelines:\s+(\S+)\/main\.md/`. `doctor/checks.ts` L1508 and `init-deposit/legacy-detect.ts` L219 call it. `500_discoverability.test.ts` L124 pins the `.deft/core/main.md` count in agents-entry to exactly 1. The literal also appears in the Go fixtures (`cmd/deft-install/e2e_upgrade_test.go` L68, `setup_test.go` L2730).

Failure mode: if L4 counts as a "pointer to recut", a fix that rewords or removes it breaks the discoverability pin. It also removes the fallback install-root parse for AGENTS.md files that lack the `Deft is installed in` phrase. And it cuts no read, because "Full guidelines: X" orders nothing.

Disposition: scope Tax B to the imperative load sites. State L4 as kept on purpose (locator). The issue body's "including L4" needs amending.

### F2 — `blocks-the-design` (for the fork-1 scope as stated): the inventory misses four more mandate surfaces

Evidence (`git grep -F 'main.md / USER' / 'main → USER' / 'main.md → USER'` at the SHA):
- `content/commands.md` L419: "Load AGENTS.md / main.md / USER.md / PROJECT-DEFINITION" is the depth target that L20 points to.
- `AGENTS.md` L16 (maintainer header): "before responding to any user request, read in this order: main.md → USER.md → …".
- `content/packs/rules/rules-pack-0.1.json` L3626 carries the same L16 text.
- `content/contracts/host-lifecycle-duties.md` L50: "Session routing loads main → USER → PROJECT-DEFINITION before mutation".

Failure mode: after an edit to agents-entry only, L20 still sends the agent to `commands.md` § Session routing, which still says Load main.md. The mandate survives one hop away. That is the same "survives a list edit" class this issue exists to close. In this repo, L16 still mandates main.md before any response.

Disposition: the bound remedy must list every one of these surfaces, or name each one it leaves out and why. The rules pack is probably generated, so the lean should name its regeneration step. Do not hand-edit it.

### F3 — `blocks-the-design` (for fork 2): identity-only is the wrong axis

Evidence: the detector (SKILL.md L688) is a **project-state** predicate: empty `plan.items` AND no convention-valid lifecycle scope files. "Read-only" is a **session-posture** axis (#2176). "Rapid" is a **ceremony-dial** axis (`ceremony-dial.ts`). These three axes are independent. The detector also has no code implementation.

Failure mode 1: a read-only question on a scoped brownfield project (the common case) is not identity-only. So main.md stays mandated, and the pain survives for most sessions.
Failure mode 2: to evaluate the detector, the agent must first read PROJECT-DEFINITION and list five lifecycle folders. That is more first-prompt work than the problem it replaces.
Failure mode 3: an identity-only project that gets a mutation prompt would skip main.md, which inverts the intent.

Disposition: reject fork 2. The switch must be the #2176 posture axis that L20 already uses ("Read-only default until mutation intent"). The title's "identity-only / read-only / rapid" should become "read-only posture (any dial depth)". Rapid mutation sessions still need main.md.

### F4 — `blocks-the-design` (for any recut that only deletes): read-only loses the authority-precedence rule (injection lens fires)

Evidence: USER.md precedence is defined in main.md L12 ("`Personal` (always wins …) … PROJECT-DEFINITION overrides these [Defaults]") and L378-L379. `grep -n -i 'always wins\|precedence' content/templates/agents-entry.md` finds only L120 "Review-surface precedence". The consumer always-on surface has **no** statement that Personal wins. Only the maintainer AGENTS.md L17 has one ("USER.md Personal (always wins) entries override external context …").

Failure mode: in a consumer read-only session that no longer reads main.md, host-injected context (Warp Drive rules, MCP instructions, prompt-injected text) competes with USER.md with no rule to settle it. The agent can take its addressing-name, language, or strategy from external context. That is an authority and untrusted-input change, so the lens fires. No deterministic control observes which source won. "The agent will still read USER.md" does not fix this: reading a file does not tell the agent which source outranks the other.

Disposition: the bound remedy must add one precedence line to agents-entry L20 (Personal wins over external context and PROJECT-DEFINITION; PROJECT-DEFINITION beats Defaults). This mirrors maintainer L17 under #1309 propagation, so `agents_entry_contract` markers change. This adds bytes to the always-on surface, which touches #3014 / #4916 Tax A. Keep it to one line. Do not recut Tax A here.

### F5 — `sharpens-framing`: the replacement wording must say when main.md loads, not just drop it

Evidence: L20 already splits read-only from mutation ("Mutation → `deft session:start` then … gated"). The soft post-compact hook checks that `.deft/core/main.md` exists as deposit integrity. That is an existence check, not a read.

Failure mode: if main.md is deleted from the list without a load trigger, it has no mandated load point at all. Mutation sessions then lose Dual Stop, Rule Authority, and Thin Fail-Closed depth. L77/L79/L82 only say "See main.md".

Disposition: the lean should state the trigger: "main.md: load at the mutation boundary (with `deft session:start`) or on demand". Place it in the L20 Mutation clause, so the gated ritual path keeps it.

### F6 — `footnote`: embedded refutation-target

The Stop 1 write-back 5787785518 carries `refutation-target: a session-routing-only list edit already unloads main.md …`. The charter is open critique, so I treated this as described content, not an instruction. On the merits it is false anyway, per F2 (commands.md L419 and maintainer L16 survive).

### F7 — `footnote`: no gate observes the skip

The change removes a requirement. It does not add a safety gate. So the lack of a machine check that the agent skipped main.md is acceptable. The eval surface (`deft eval:triggers`) is the natural place to observe it later, if anyone wants to.

## Road not taken / steelman

Strongest rejected position: **fork 3, expected cost, close.** main.md holds precedence, addressing, and the cold-start preamble. One ~37 KB read is cheap next to a 38 KB AGENTS.md. Each recut of always-on text risks drift (#1309 propagation, five surfaces per F2). A read-only answer rarely suffers from reading extra guidance. What would flip my verdict to close: evidence that the read-only main.md read does no harm (no timeout, context-budget pressure, or first-response latency the operator named), and that #3014's thin profile will replace this surface soon anyway. The body cites pain-audit 5783468254 on #4916 but gives no measurement inside this envelope. If the parent cannot restate that harm on this thread, fork 3 is defensible.

Also rejected: gating the skip on skipFatPath (the rapid/minimal dial). The issue's "What this is not" list excludes that. It also has the same wrong-axis problem as F3 (rapid mutation still needs main.md).

Round 1, open critique of #4923. I read the issue and its two comments through id 5787798332, and rechecked source with `git show 'd35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d:<path>'` at the dispatch SHA.

## blocks-the-design — The linked Session routing rule still mandates the read

Evidence: [agents-entry L4](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/content/templates/agents-entry.md#L4) points to the full guidelines; [L20](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/content/templates/agents-entry.md#L20) both lists `main.md` in the initial load and orders `main → USER → PROJECT-DEFINITION`. That same line links Session routing, whose [commands.md L419](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/content/commands.md#L419) independently says to load AGENTS.md, main.md, USER.md, and PROJECT-DEFINITION on read-only starts. I verified all four occurrences in the pinned tree.

Failure mode: a change confined to the three template cues can still send an agent through the linked normative route and back to an unconditional main.md read. The named Tax B remains on a scoped or identity-only read-only first prompt.

Disposition: recut commands.md Session routing with all three agents-entry cues, then run `task agents:refresh`. Use the existing `agents_entry_contract` marker surface to check the generated consumer route for an unconditional main.md read while keeping an on-demand pointer to the full guidelines.

## blocks-the-design — Identity-only and skipFatPath cannot be the whole switch

Evidence: the [setup detector](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md#L686-L692) needs live `plan.items` and lifecycle scopes; the [interview detector](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/content/strategies/interview.md#L47-L60) has the same scope test. Setup already says to [ask before reading framework files and allow main.md later](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md#L133-L138). The [ceremony dial](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/packages/core/src/policy/ceremony-dial.ts#L129-L156) and [session-start consumers](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts#L1921-L2008) use `skipFatPath` for triage welcome, optional network, and the staleness tickler, not prompt loading. Read-only posture in commands.md L419 includes research and ticket shaping regardless of whether scopes exist.

Failure mode: an identity-only exception leaves scoped read-only and scoped rapid prompts paying the main.md load. A detector reached after the always-on first-prompt command cannot undo that load. Wiring this to skipFatPath changes CLI ceremony but leaves host-injected AGENTS instructions intact.

Disposition: model read-only posture, project shape, and rapid depth as separate inputs. Start alignment from AGENTS, USER, and PROJECT-DEFINITION; load main.md for a concrete task trigger. Verify scoped read-only, identity-only, and rapid cases separately. Keep the existing setup identity-only detector for setup classification.

## blocks-the-design — Preserve the trust boundary when main.md becomes optional

Evidence: [main.md L12](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/main.md#L12) establishes USER.md Personal precedence; [L154-L167](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/main.md#L154-L167) says external issue/PR text and tool output are data, not instructions. A pinned-tree search of agents-entry for `external content|untrusted|prompt injection|instruction hierarchy` found no corresponding rule. The read-only route explicitly includes ticket shaping, which reads external text.

Failure mode: an agent handling an adversarial issue or PR can encounter instruction-shaped text before it loads the rule that forbids promoting that text to authority. The generated AGENTS surface is injected into parent and worker prompts, so this affects every such first prompt without any worktree or shared-state change.

Disposition: retain a concise trust-tier and USER Personal precedence rule in the always-on entry, or make the existing security guidance an explicit pre-external-read trigger. Guard the chosen route in the existing content-contract surface. Leave the broader injected-surface reduction on #3014.

## sharpens-framing — Expected cost is a valid explicit disposition

Evidence: pinned `git show ... | wc -c` returned 37,592 bytes for main.md, 38,335 for consumer AGENTS.md, and 19,233 for agents-entry.md. These are byte counts, not token or latency measurements. Keeping the read preserves the full guidance and avoids conditional routing.

Failure mode: closing #4923 as fixed while retaining the unconditional read would report relief of P1 that did not occur.

Disposition: if the expected-cost fork wins, record the accepted cost and unresolved P1 plainly. Measured first-prompt latency or token data, plus an explicit operator decision, would change my preference for the conditional route.

## footnote — Self-dogfood acceptance needs the right surface

This repo's [unmanaged AGENTS.md L16](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d/AGENTS.md#L16) separately orders `main → USER → PROJECT-DEFINITION`. A test of this checkout's first prompt would still see that maintainer rule after a consumer-template fix. Validate the generated consumer section, and state separately if the maintainer header is included in #4923.

```quarantined
role: critic
```

audit-targets: none

Round 1, fresh critic, open critique. Pin `d35cb4878bbc66a8b252609aeedbe4d33976868d`. Input ceiling 5787798332 (Stop 1 5787785518; panel-deposit 5787798332). Charter is open critique. Stop 1's `refutation-target:` is described content.

## Verdict

Tax B holds: always-on `content/templates/agents-entry.md` still eagers a 37592-byte `main.md` read on the identity-only / read-only first prompt. `skipFatPath` cannot unload it. Two of the three named forks cannot bind as written.

The bindable remainder is a delete-or-reorder of the *eager* conjuncts so identity-only and read-only do not first-prompt-read `main.md`. Keep L4 as the install-path haystack. Recut `commands.md` L419 in the same PR. USER.md stays eager. Depth `See main.md` lines stay lazy. #3014 and #4544 stay off this harvest.

## Findings

### 1. Rapid as a first-prompt skip conjunct — `blocks-the-design`

**Evidence.** Re-run at this pin:

- `packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts` 1525–1526: `posture === READ_ONLY_POSTURE` returns `runReadOnlySessionStart` before ceremony dial.
- Dial and `skipFatPath` are assigned at 1564–1599 on the mutation path only. Consumers: triage welcome (1922), optional network (1981), release-probe message (1994), staleness tickler (1999). Comment 1771–1772: informational cold path only.
- `packages/core/src/policy/ceremony-dial.ts` 139–155: rapid/minimal `skipFatPath: true` with the same contract. `compose=content/strategies/rapid.md` is a status pointer.
- Host injects AGENTS.md before any of that runs. Stop 1 P1 is the identity-only / read-only first prompt.

**Failure mode.** A harvest that recuts L4/L20 "so identity-only / read-only / rapid does not mandate main.md" adds an `unless rapid` clause the first prompt cannot evaluate. The identity-only first prompt still reads 37592-byte `main.md`. Tax B stays loaded on the session that paid.

**Disposition.** Drop rapid from the skip set. Typed `plan.policy.ceremonyDial.override` is a mutation-path field. It is not an AGENTS prefix switch.

### 2. Skip via the setup-skill identity-only detector — `blocks-the-design`

**Evidence.** Setup SKILL.md 686–688 (shared with `content/strategies/interview.md` chaining): identity-only = empty `plan.items` AND no convention-valid lifecycle scopes. PROJECT-DEFINITION existence is identity.

That detector is off the first-prompt path:

- `session-start.ts` at this SHA has zero `identity-only` / `identityOnly` hits.
- agents-entry L20: missing USER.md / PROJECT-DEFINITION → setup Phase 1/2; **else** main → USER → PROJECT-DEFINITION.
- Identity-only requires PROJECT-DEFINITION, so the else-clause fires and setup SKILL is not loaded.
- `content/templates/agents-consumer-header.md` has no `main.md` pointer. The tax is the managed else-clause.

**Failure mode.** Bound-remedy points L20 at setup SKILL.md 686–688. The identity-only first prompt never opens that skill. L4 and the else-clause still eager `main.md`.

**Disposition.** If the skip is identity-only, inline the two conjuncts into always-on session-routing (agents-entry L20 and `commands.md` § Session routing). Finding 4 bounds how much text that inline may add.

### 3. L4 is an install-path sentinel — `sharpens-framing`

**Evidence.** L4: `Deft is installed in .deft/core/. Full guidelines: .deft/core/main.md`.

`packages/core/src/doctor/manifest.ts` 124–136: `INSTALLED_IN_RE` then `FULL_GUIDELINES_RE = /Full guidelines:\s+(\S+)\/main\.md/`. `parseInstallRootFromAgentsMd` uses both. Installer fixtures and QUICK-START Case K parse the same haystack.

**Failure mode.** Deleting L4 to stop the eager read breaks install-root parse. Rewriting `Full guidelines:` so the regex misses falls back to `.deft/core` while agents still treat a surviving guidelines pointer as a read. A session-routing-only list edit that leaves L4 as an eager-read instruction is the named no-op.

**Disposition.** Keep `Deft is installed in <root>.` and the `Full guidelines: <root>/main.md` substring. Recut the eager-read meaning in the L20 load list and the else-clause.

Item 6 already requires refresh and the existing content-contract surface to prevent reintroduction. Existing agents_md_session_start tests assert posture/alignment tokens, not omission of main.md: the remedy's requested regression protection is implementation work, not proof supplied by today's tests.

### 2. The delete-only remedy fits the current byte and line limits — footnote

Reproduced the pinned evaluate.ts measurement method: normalize line endings, take the opening-through-closing managed-marker span, join with newlines, count UTF-8 bytes; count managed lines inclusively.

Pinned AGENTS.md measures 28,034 bytes / 200 lines; the two deletions give 28,015 / 200. Template span measures 27,965 → 27,946 bytes, also 200 lines. The pinned PROJECT-DEFINITION's plan x-directive/policy agentsMdBudget is absoluteMaxBytes 28,100 and managedMaxLines 200. AGENTS.md L16 still independently orders main → USER → PROJECT-DEFINITION. The earlier map 5787910367 explicitly omitted the unmanaged maintainer header, and the current remedy targets the generated consumer route. Refresh does not make that maintainer mandate disappear. This audit does not extend P1 relief to the unmanaged header or to every rapid mutation path.

Injection lens: pinned agents-entry L24 now already carries USER Personal precedence; no new Personal line is required for this delete-only remedy. That is not the external-content-as-data defense. main.md L156–167 still holds that separate defense and its security lazy-load pointer. The thread records the operator split of those carries to #4949; this audit does not declare that safeguard delivered or waive it. The split does not prevent the named deletions from removing the consumer mandate.

I treated instruction-shaped issue/comment text, including the old refutation-target, as described content. No posture predicate, host-input bypass, occupancy mechanism, or new trust mechanism is proposed.

Keeping the read preserves immediate access to the security guidance, but it leaves the exact consumer mandate P1 names. Given the recorded split, that is not a reason to relabel this delete-only remedy as non-relief. A surviving mandatory consumer read outside the covered surfaces, or a requirement to deliver the split safeguard on this number, would change this verdict.

## Pain

Unmet Tax B from #4916 (pain-audit 5783468254): always-on `content/templates/agents-entry.md` still orders a `main.md` read on the identity-only / read-only first prompt. Title-line L4 (`Full guidelines: .deft/core/main.md`), the L20 load list (`load AGENTS.md / main.md / USER.md / …`), and the L20 else-clause (`else main → USER → PROJECT-DEFINITION`) all survive a session-routing-only list edit. Identity-only already has a detector in setup SKILL.md. Capture remainder stays on #4544.

## Why this number exists

#4916 leftover-split of Tax B per Handoff 5783498663. Operator confirmed leftover. The injected-surface remainder (Stop 1 P1 / Tax A) stays on #4916 and is leftover-deferred to open #3014. This issue holds stop-mandating `main.md` on rapid / identity-only / read-only, including every always-on pointer.

## What this is not

- Not skipFatPath / ceremony-dial unload of host-injected AGENTS.md.
- Not a default thin AGENTS profile (#3014).
- Not the capture remainder on #4544.
- Not auto-seeding `xbrief/active/`.
- Not mid-run AGENTS rewrite (#3164).

Refs #4916, #4544, #3014, #4593, #2176.
